title: Authority
hook: You've got real credentials and experience. You're just hiding them where no buyer will ever see them.
statement: People trust credible expertise, so make your real authority easy to see.
explainer: When buyers can see you know your stuff, they decide faster. One real expert endorsement can beat a much bigger ad budget. Just never fake it. Getting caught wrecks trust.
sop: List your real credentials, wins, and expertise.
Put them where buyers actually look.
Get the experts on your team speaking publicly.
Never claim authority you don't have.
equation_example: Score each 1 to 10. Credentials 6, Expertise Visibility 5, Relevance 9. (6 + 5 + 9) ÷ 3 = 6.7. Higher means your authority shortens the buyer's decision. Lower means the proof is hidden or doesn't fit what they're deciding.
question: Write down your three strongest real credentials and check whether they're on your sales page.
closing_statement: Real authority doesn't need to be exaggerated to work.
caption:
Principle Nº 303: Authority

You've got real credentials and experience. You're just hiding them where no buyer will ever see them.

People trust credible expertise, so make your real authority easy to see.

Your turn: Write down your three strongest real credentials and check whether they're on your sales page.
